departments.purpose: Organizational departments that group employees and designate a managing employee.

columns.department_name: Name of the department, e.g. Engineering, Sales.
columns.location: Office location the department is based in.
columns.manager_employee_id: Employee who heads this department. References employees.employee_id.

employees.purpose: Employee master data: identity, job title, department, reporting line, and current employment status. The table to use for onboarding a new employee, updating their role or manager, or recording a termination.

columns.department_id: Department the employee belongs to. References departments.department_id.
columns.manager_id: Employee this person reports to. References employees.employee_id (self-referential, nullable for top-level roles).
columns.termination_date: Date employment ended, set only when employment_status is terminated.

salary_history.purpose: Time-stamped record of every salary an employee has been assigned, including the initial hire salary and any subsequent raises or adjustments.

columns.employee_id: Employee this salary record belongs to. References employees.employee_id.
columns.currency: Currency code for the salary amount.
columns.reason: Why this salary record was created: hire, raise, promotion, or adjustment.

timesheets.purpose: Daily hours logged by employees, including overtime, subject to manager approval.

columns.employee_id: Employee who logged the hours. References employees.employee_id.
columns.hours_worked: Regular hours worked on this date.
columns.overtime_hours: Overtime hours worked on this date, beyond the regular hours.
columns.approved_by: Employee who approved or rejected the timesheet. References employees.employee_id, nullable until reviewed.

leave_requests.purpose: Employee requests for time off, subject to approval.

columns.start_date: First day of the requested leave.
columns.end_date: Last day of the requested leave.

deduction_types.purpose: Catalog of payroll deduction types (taxes, benefits) and their default calculation rules.

columns.name: Unique name of the deduction, e.g. federal_tax, health_insurance, retirement_401k.
columns.calculation_type: How the deduction is calculated: flat (fixed amount) or percentage (of gross pay).
columns.default_value: Default flat amount or percentage applied when an employee has no override.

employee_deductions.purpose: Which deduction types apply to which employees, with optional per-employee overrides of the default value.

columns.employee_id: Employee the deduction applies to. References employees.employee_id.
columns.deduction_type_id: Deduction type being applied. References deduction_types.deduction_type_id.
columns.value: Overrides deduction_types.default_value for this employee when set; NULL means use the default.
columns.active: Whether this deduction is currently applied (1) or suspended (0).

payroll_runs.purpose: A payroll processing batch for a given pay period, tracking its overall status.

columns.pay_period_start: First day of the pay period covered by this run.
columns.pay_period_end: Last day of the pay period covered by this run.
columns.run_date: Date the payroll run was executed.
columns.status: One of draft, processing, finalized, rolled_back.

payroll_entries.purpose: Per-employee pay calculation output produced when a payroll run is processed: gross pay, total deductions, and net pay for that pay period. This is the result of running payroll, not where an employee's compensation is set up (see salary_history for that).

columns.payroll_run_id: Payroll run this entry belongs to. References payroll_runs.payroll_run_id.
columns.gross_pay: Total pay before deductions for this pay period.
columns.total_deductions: Sum of all deductions applied for this pay period.
columns.net_pay: Pay after deductions: gross_pay minus total_deductions.
